# owner of

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:ownerOf`](gmeow-ownerOf.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/ownerOf>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/organization`](../../slices/organization.md)

Relates an agent to something it owns — an organization, an asset, a work. Non-functional and standpoint-indexable (contested ownership coexists, P9). The flat shortcut; promote to an ownership relator (with share, period, jurisdiction) when those matter. Projects to [schema:owns.](https://schema.org/owns.)
